thesis: Bottleneck unchanged: HBM/memory scarcity (MU) with power (PWR, GEV, ETN) as the secondary constraint on GW-scale buildouts. Today's seed research is general industry news (AMD/Taalas ASIC deal, DeepMind departures, Meta's Muse Spark 1.2) rather than evidence of a bottleneck shift, and macro is calm (VIX -5.8%, yields flat), so no trades today.
